name: brave-barber
description: Brave Barber — agendamento, pedidos, balcão e administração da barbearia

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gray,white "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
